comment: Hard no-go polygons. Cells inside these are scored zero for every species.
The Mirna estuary polygon below is APPROXIMATE - drawn generously around the
river mouth, not traced from the legal boundary. It deliberately over-covers:
excluding water you could legally hunt costs you a spot, while missing a
restricted zone costs you a fine. Replace it with the real boundary when you
have it, and add any other protected areas, port limits or no-take zones.
Verify against the current rules at ribarstvo.mps.hr.

Croatian rules also prohibit fishing in ports and harbours, within 200 m of fish farms / 100 m of shellfish farms, and on beaches and swimming areas from 1 May to 1 October. The last one is seasonal and needs beach polygons - it is NOT encoded here. Watch for it yourself in summer.
